hooks.command: python -c "import sys, json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); cmd=data.get('toolCall',{}).get('args',{}).get('CommandLine',''); blocked=['docker compose down -v', 'DROP DATABASE', 'systemctl poweroff', 'systemctl reboot']; match=any(b.lower() in cmd.lower() for b in blocked); print(json.dumps({'decision': 'deny', 'reason': 'Destructive operation blocked by safety-guard hook'} if match else {'decision': 'allow'}))"
